<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 211.0764, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈210.069 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₀O₂ matches this exact mass (210.0681 Da) within ~1 mDa and reproduces the observed M+1 isotopic intensity (~12 % vs the expected ~15 % from 14 ¹³C atoms). No other simple formula fits as well. Therefore the molecular formula is C14H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H10O2</final_answer>
